findings.claim: The assessment makes stop conditions normative that are never defined or assessed in the artifact, leaving Plan unable to implement or test them without inventing definitions.
findings.evidence: Boundary item 7 requires stopping at 'unsafe credential source, privacy-cap failure or operator interruption,' and SPEC GAP SUMMARY states 'The 30-second active cap remains an outer bound.' No section assesses where the collector obtains credentials, what makes a credential source 'unsafe,' what the privacy cap is or how it is enforced, or where the 30-second cap originates. With prior_handoffs null in the packet, these predicates have no verifiable source, yet they are required behaviors and (per item 8) required test assertions.
findings.suggested_fix: Define each stop predicate inline (credential acquisition mechanism and rejection criteria, the concrete privacy-cap rule, the cap's origin and value) or explicitly cite the prior-child artifact that defines them so Plan can derive testable behavior.

findings.claim: The required synthetic test list does not explicitly cover all stop conditions the SPEC GAP SUMMARY declares mandatory.
findings.evidence: SPEC GAP SUMMARY requires that 'A second Ping, Pong, Close, fragment, binary frame, reserved opcode, masked server frame, extension-marked frame, non-minimal length or oversized Text response must stop the attempt without retry,' but boundary item 8's required cases list only 'repeated Ping rejection, nonzero Ping rejection, unexpected control/data forms.' Close-from-server, masked server frame, non-minimal length encoding, and oversized Text response have no named test case; whether the catch-all 'unexpected control/data forms' covers them is ambiguous for the Plan stage.
findings.suggested_fix: Enumerate the required cases one-to-one with the stop conditions (Close, masked server frame, non-minimal length, oversized Text, fragment/binary/reserved-opcode) or state explicitly that the catch-all case is parameterized over each of them.
